hooks.name: Check MCP Server Venv
hooks.description: Checks if the olive-mcp-server Python venv exists and has deps installed on session start. Warns if setup is needed.

action.command: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "if (-not (Test-Path 'olive-mcp-server/.venv/Scripts/python.exe') -and -not (Test-Path 'olive-mcp-server/.venv/bin/python')) { Write-Output 'WARNING: Olive MCP Server venv not found. Run: .\\scripts\\setup-mcp.ps1 (or ./scripts/setup-mcp.sh on Linux/macOS) to set up the MCP server with semantic search support.' } else { $ver = & 'olive-mcp-server/.venv/Scripts/python.exe' -c 'import mcp; print(mcp.__version__)' 2>&1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Output 'WARNING: MCP server deps may be incomplete. Run: .\\scripts\\setup-mcp.ps1 to reinstall.' } }"
